text.content:
Muscle you can hire, if you can afford it.

Turf: None to speak of; their gym is the Tripple Xtreme Epic Workout Center in Rancho Coronado
Known for: Growth hormones and "the Juice" instead of chrome; trial by combat
Hangouts: Underground fight circuits and death matches

Animals scorn combat cyberware. They build themselves with tailored hormones and a secret compound called the Juice, and settle every dispute, even among themselves, by fighting it out.

They hire out as muscle, run underground death matches, and raid homes, corporate supply houses and other gangs' stashes.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.25
